# password-record-verification

行为约定：
accounts.service.create(password,salt) uses a 16-byte Buffer salt to return 's1$<32 lowercase salt hex>$<64 lowercase digest hex>'. Digest is scryptSync over exact password UTF-8 bytes and binary salt, keylen=32, N=1024,r=8,p=1. No Unicode normalization. Invalid create salt throws TypeError. verify(password,record) returns a boolean, uses timingSafeEqual for valid records, and returns false without throwing for ANY malformed record. Records must have exactly three fields, version s1, strictly lowercase fixed-length hex; do not accept truncated or odd hex. No I/O or random salt generation is needed.

运行：`node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。
